registryEvidence: The official Guangxi Natural Resources Department announcement describes the Guangxi online real-estate-registration '以图询房' service, using Tianditu Guangxi for visual cadastral-map queries and providing registered parcel natural-condition/cadastral-map results. The announcement names the public portal https://bdc.dnr.gx.gov.cn/index. This evidences a first-party regional service covering Guangxi; a separate Lingshan county registry custodian page was not verified.
